content:
@Tatted.Tiara 的整合包

 

本整合包融合了实用类模组以提升游戏体验，同时包含增添魔法元素的模组。整合包规模适中，对设备性能要求不高。其主要目标仅仅是基于原版《我的世界》已有的内容进行扩展。

 

模组列表：
  • Treecapitator Updated (by ZenCoder)
  • Botania (by Vazkii_)
  • Improved Backpacks (by DreenDex)
  • Forestry (by SirSengir)
  • Biomes O' Plenty (by Forstride)
  • Dynamic Lights (by AtomicStryker)
  • Thaumcraft (by Azanor13)
  • CraftStudio API (by ZeAmateis)
  • Astral Sorcery (by HellFirePvP)（仅限 2.0 版本。不兼容 BSL 光影！！）
  • Pam's HarvestCraft (by MatrexsVigil)
  • CodeChicken Lib 1.8.+ (by covers1624)
  • Mo' Creatures (by DrZhark)
  • BiblioCraft (by JDSinclair)
  • Chameleon (by jaquadro)
  • Serene Seasons (by Forstride)
  • Baubles (by Azanor13)
  • Animania (by Purplicious_Cow)
  • JourneyMap (by techbrew)
  • Wings (by pau101)
  • MrCrayfish's Furniture Mod (by Mr_Crayfish)
  • Minecraft Comes Alive (MCA) (by WildBamaBoy)
  • Better Animals Plus (by cybercat5555)
  • Keeping Inventory (by Silly511)
  • Just Enough Items (JEI) (by mezz)
  • LLibrary (by iLexiconn)
  • bspkrsCore Updated (by ZenCoder)
  • Garden Stuff (by jaquadro)
  • Better Diving (by meldexun)
  • Not Enough Items 1.8.+ (by covers1624)
  • Hwyla (by TehNut)
